keyEvents.text: Goal! Newport County 0, Walsall 1. Andy Dallas (Walsall) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner.
Goal! Newport County 1, Walsall 1. Kion Etete (Newport County) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Ciarán Brennan.
